name: immersive-themes
title: Immersive Themes
description: Club, Exclusive, Private and Ultra as --immersive-* properties, and the adapter that themes shadcn/ui inside a [data-immersive-theme] scope.

files.content:
/* Generated by theme/scripts/generate-immersive-themes.mjs from theme/immersive-themes.json. Do not hand-edit. */

/* Secondary colours, available in every theme */
[data-immersive-theme] {
  --immersive-green-100: #00e76b; /* Green.100 */
  --immersive-on-green-100: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */
  --immersive-green-75: #40ed90; /* Green.75 */
  --immersive-on-green-75: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */
  --immersive-green-50: #80f3b5; /* Green.50 */

  --immersive-green-25: #bff9da; /* Green.25 */
  --immersive-on-green-25: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */

  --immersive-on-blue-100: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */
  --immersive-blue-75: #7cdbff; /* Blue.75 */
  --immersive-on-blue-75: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */
  --immersive-blue-50: #a8e7ff; /* Blue.50 */

  --immersive-blue-25: #d3f3ff; /* Blue.25 */

  --immersive-purple-25: #ead1f0; /* Purple.25 */
  --immersive-on-purple-25: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */
  --immersive-red-100: #f73232; /* Red.100 */
  --immersive-on-red-100: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */
  --immersive-red-75: #f96565; /* Red.75 */
  --immersive-on-red-75: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */

/* Club: White 60 / Light Grey 15 / Yellow 15 / Navy 10 */
[data-immersive-theme="club"] {
  --immersive-canvas: #ffffff; /* White.100 */
  --immersive-text: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */
  --immersive-palette-100: #a6bfcc; /* Light Grey.100 */
  --immersive-on-palette-100: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */

  --immersive-on-palette-50: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */
  --immersive-palette-25: #e9eff2; /* Light Grey.25 */
  --immersive-on-palette-25: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */
  --immersive-accent-100: #f2f93c; /* Yellow.100 */
  --immersive-on-accent-100: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */
  --immersive-accent-75: #f5fb6d; /* Yellow.75 */
  --immersive-on-accent-75: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */
  --immersive-accent-50: #f9fc9e; /* Yellow.50 */
  --immersive-on-accent-50: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */
  --immersive-accent-25: #fcfece; /* Yellow.25 */
  --immersive-on-accent-25: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */
  --immersive-action: #01172b; /* Navy.100 */
  --immersive-on-action: #ffffff; /* White.100 */
  background: var(--immersive-canvas);
  color: var(--immersive-text);
}
